bio:
Tree: Maria Morrello (1786-1846), wife of Domenico G. Fiorillo; parents Vincenzo Morrello M... (1759-1836) + Ippolita Guercio N... (1761-1831). Round 2: Morrello/Morello has 0 entries in San Mango's stati 1674-1804, including fuzzy spellings, and the couple would have been listed in 1800/1804. Round 3: Carmine's death act gives 'Vittoria Marrelli/Morelli'. The whole Morrello/Guercio/Chiarello pedigree above her is flagged unsupported.

Maria Marrello (the tree's 'Morrello') was buried at San Mango on 20 March 1846, aged 60. She is named as the daughter of the late Vincenzo Marrello and of Giacinta Gabriele Fiorillo, and as the wife of Domenico Gabriele Fiorillo ([R4-S1]). Her son Carmine's 1840 marriage names her, still living, as his mother ([R4-S2]). Her daughters Cintia and Antonia were born at Aiello Calabro ([R4-S3]). Her father Vincenzo matches the tree. Her mother is given as Giacinta Gabriele Fiorillo, not the tree's Ippolita Guercio Nuzio. She is therefore a direct ancestor (Carmine's mother), replacing 'Vittoria Marrelli'.
